evidence: The paper uses "the top 20 most important genera" for network construction but bases substantive conclusions on PLS models, SEM analysis (e.g., "Paludibacter P = 0.001"), Wilcoxon rank-sum tests for differential pathway abundance, and literature on bacterial functions. The main claims about energy-maximization vs. protein-maximization strategies rest on which microbes are differentially abundant and their known roles, not on impurity importance magnitudes. No importance p-values (Altmann, Janitza, Boruta) are used.
